narrative.overview:
BrickPulse uses a light, precise workbench for engineers investigating Databricks spend and leaders reading the same evidence at a glance. Cool neutral surroundings, white work surfaces, graphite text and a petrol accent make financial facts, priorities and resource relationships easy to scan. Density comes from compact typography, aligned values and restrained dividers.

The visual system keeps explanation beside the number: scope, period, confidence, source and freshness remain legible context. Panels organize evidence without decorative depth. The original Frequência mark provides identity through five rounded bars in Logo Orange; charts, tables and text provide the substance. The implemented interface requires no photographic or illustrative raster assets.
keyCharacteristics: Light neutral canvas and white analytical surfaces.
Graphite reading text with petrol actions, selection and opportunity values.
The original five-bar Frequência logo in orange, separate from the petrol interface accent.
Instrument Sans for interface language; JetBrains Mono for values and technical evidence.
Flat panels, precise dividers and compact controls.
Explicit financial context, honest unavailable states and accessible data alternatives.

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Use petrol for actions, selection and opportunity emphasis; retain graphite for the implemented observed data series. A color alone must not establish whether a value is observed, estimated, unavailable or synthetic.

rules.name: The Display and Data Rule
rules.body: Keep interface language in Instrument Sans and comparable values or technical evidence in JetBrains Mono. Right-align numeric table cells and retain tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Locale Rule
rules.body: Format visible currency, numbers and dates for pt-BR, English or Spanish while keeping USD and the underlying calculations independent of language. Preserve text wrapping for localized labels.

rules.name: The Table Continuity Rule
rules.body: Preserve the table's columns in a horizontally scrollable, focusable region with an accessible caption/name. Keep numeric values unbroken and aligned; do not remove evidence columns to make a phone screenshot fit. The current review confirmed this structure in source but did not exercise scrolling or keyboard behavior.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Use borders and surface tones for analytical grouping; reserve the existing shadow for the floating menu.

rules.name: The Shape Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Keep work surfaces, controls and status tags on their existing separate corner sizes; this small hierarchy supplies the workbench's form language.

rules.name: The Original Logo Rule
rules.body: Use the exact original Frequência symbol from `frontend/logo-options/svg/03-frequencia-symbol-color.svg`, preserving all five rounded bars, their positions and Logo Orange. The sidebar and favicon use the same SVG; do not redraw, recolor or combine the approved symbol with another mark.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Keep period, source, confidence, freshness and estimate caveats close to the amount they explain. Preserve visible demo labeling and distinguish estimated opportunity from observed spend or tracked changes; never imply an invoice or guaranteed saving.

dos: Do preserve the cool neutral canvas, white surfaces, graphite text and petrol action/selection accent.
Do separate interface typography from tabular numeric and technical typography.
Do keep financial period, source, confidence, freshness and estimate caveats beside their values.
Do retain meaningful status text, visible focus and horizontal access to complete tables.
Do carry workspace scope and localized formatting consistently between routes.
donts: Don't render missing information as zero spend or no opportunity.
Don't present estimates as invoices, guaranteed savings or executed resource changes.
Don't rely on color alone to distinguish observed, estimated, unavailable or demo information.
Don't replace the flat panel hierarchy with decorative elevation.
Don't remove financial context or evidence columns to compress a narrow layout.
